Video and animations

Hiking and Äscher cliff restaurant

Nowhere else in Switzerland is the change from the hilly landscape of Central Switzerland to the craggy alpine scenery so abrupt or impressive as in the Alpstein area.

Ebenalp and Wildkirchli

Already Neanderthal men were here where today a cableway sweeps visitors up.

Montreux Riviera

The town of Montreux nestles in a sheltered Lake Geneva bay, surrounded by vineyards and against the breathtaking backdrop of snow-covered Alps.

Bern Cathedral

The Bern Münster Cathedral of St. Vincent is the most impressive late-Gothic building in the city.

City breaks

City breaks are a brief escape from everyday life – and our Swiss Boutique Towns are perfect for the occasion.

Not many cities have managed to retain their historic features quite as successfully as Bern, the capital of Switzerland.

Dream route Airolo - Gletsch

From Airolo, the historic pass road snakes around hairpin bends up to the Gotthard.

Swiss Alps Jungfrau-Aletsch

The Jungfrau-Aletsch Region was chosen as the first Alpine UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site in 2001.

Glaciers

Venture out onto eternal ice and explore our country’s many glaciers.

Oberhofen Castle - Living Museum and Park

The castle, which dates back to the early 13th century, houses a living museum.

Lake Thun

Lake Thun is especially popular amongst sailors and windsurfers who appreciate the prevailing light breeze.

Swimming in the Rhine through the historic old town

Thousands of people cool off by leaping into the refreshing water during the warmer months of the year.

Home to 40 museums, the city of culture for connoisseurs has the highest concentration of museums in the country.

Nationalpark Bike-Marathon

In four one-day stages you experience the unique countryside on the National Park bike marathon route.

Swiss parcs

The Swiss parks are not just great spots for rest and relaxation, but also play a key role in the preservation of natural habitats.

With its humanitarian tradition and cosmopolitan flair, the European seat of the UNO and headquarters of the Red Cross is known as the «capital of peace».

Jet d'Eau

In Geneva harbour, known as “La Rade”, this water jet up to 140 metres high is a real eye-catcher.

The village of Appenzell and the Canton of Appenzell Innerrhoden are situated in a singularly beautiful landscape of rolling hills.

Appenzeller® Cheese

The country’s spiciest cheese has been made by hand in the same way for more than 700 years.

Alpine Panorama Route

The Alpine Panorama Route crosses the northern Alpine foreland with its many passes and gorges, tradition-rich culture, settlements and mountain farms.

Hallwilersee

Like the Baldeggersee lake a little further south, Lake Hallwil is located in the Seetal, a north-south valley that leads from the Lucerne hinterland to Lenzburg.

Monte Generoso

At the southern end of Lake Lugano is the 1,701 metre high Monte Generoso.

Via Albula/Bernina

Through moorland and Alpine pastures to the Berninapass. One highlight follows another.

Autumn

The forests reveal a wonderful palette of colours, leaves crunch underfoot and you can already imagine the wonderful seasonal dishes that await.

The natural, cultural and culinary highlights of this area are definitely well worth a visit.

Jura Crest Trail

The undisputed highlight of this tour across an extensive grazing area is Mont Tendre, the highest point in the Swiss Jura.

Zyt Tower, which offers a magnificent view of the Old Town, the Zug Mountain and Lake Zug, is the city's landmark.

Zug Castle Museum

With its many nooks and crannies, Zug Castle has been home to the museum of cultural history for the city and the Canton of Zug since 1983.

Creux du Van – Natural Spectacle

Impressive 160 meter high vertical rock faces surround a four kilometer long and over one kilometer wide valley basin.

Val de Travers

The Val de Tavers is characterised by the watch industry and extends from Lake Neuenburg across the Jura all the way to the French border.

LAC Arte e Cultura

The building by Ticino architect Ivano Gianola offers visitors art across 2500 square metres

With Mediterranean flair, Lugano offers all the advantages of a world-class city, combined with the cachet of a small town.

Art & culture

Switzerland is brimming with cultural surprises.

Fribourg / Freiburg

Over 200 unique Gothic facades from the 15th century impart incomparable medieval charm to the Old Town.

Cathedral of St. Nicholas

Climb the 368 steps and you will be rewarded with an unforgettable view of the town of Fribourg.

Val Calnègia

It can only be reached on foot, but the reward in the form of a submerged creek, unusual buildings and spectacular scenery is well worth the effort.

Rochers-de-Naye: mountain with a view

No two worlds could contrast more than those at the beginning and the end of the thrilling train ride from lively, sophisticated Montreux to the austere summit of Rochers-de-Naye.

The vacation region around the Black Lake and in the Eastern Freiburg Pre-Alps (Voralpen) is well-known for its authenticity and its wild, romantic natural landscape.

The cosmopolitan city by the water combines creative urban life with nature in all its glory.

Zürich West

In the last 10 years the industrial wasteland to the west of Zurich has grown into a new bright lights district.

Patinoire du Flon Lausanne

The ice rink in Flon is a great place for outdoor ice skating.

Europe’s highest suspension bridge

The suspension bridge stretches spectacularly from one rock face to the other.

Hikes to suspension bridges

Thrills over the abyss

Freestyle Academy

In Europe’s first Freestyle Indoor Base, jumps and tricks can now be practiced all year.

rockresort

From bed to board.

Panorama view

Sweeping views extend from part of Lake Lucerne as far as the Black Forest.

Gstaad attracts a charming mix of visitors.

Gstaad Saanenland ...

... a highlight on the Grand Tour of Switzerland.

Snow and piste report

Daily updated information on 250 winter sports stations.

Matterhorn – Symbol for Switzerland

The Matterhorn and Switzerland are inseparably linked to each other.

The vacation destination is a car-free zone and has preserved its original character.

Bernina Express

Fresh mountain air and stunning views from the Albula and Bernina rail lines.

Train, Bus, Boat – Grand Train Tour

The way of travelling that is as exciting as it is relaxing.

The compact metropolis of eastern Switzerland between Lake Constance and Appenzellerland with a charming, traffic-free old town.

St. Gallen Abbey District

In St. Gallen you'll find history at every turn.

13 four thousand meter peaks surround the glacier village, which is located at an altitude of 1800 meters above sea level.

On the Top of Europe: A visit to the Jungfraujoch puts a jewel in the crown of any visit to Switzerland.

Sun-drenched plateau high above the Rhone Valley.

Albert Heim Hut

The views of the Galenstock and the crystalline rock-climbing routes are stunning.

Rigi Kaltbad Swiss Quality Hotel

Enjoy the hospitality in an inspiring alpine setting.

Highland hike from Rigi-Kaltbad to Urmiberg

The highland tour from Kaltbad via the Scheidegg to Urmiberg can only be described as absolute top!

Gateway to central Switzerland.

Switzerland’s cities ...

... want to seduce you into discovering something new or experiencing something old in a new way.

Chapel Bridge and Water Tower

At the outflow of the river Reuss, a historic needle dam, built in 1860, regulates the water level of the lake.

Giessbach Falls

The Giessbach brook tumbles in 14 stages, over a length of 500 meters and out of the high valleys of the Faulhorn area down to Lake Brienz.

Waterfalls

You can feel the sheer force of the water as it thunders down into the depths.

Swiss Historic Hotels

Unique accommodation options from an unpretentious historic guesthouse to the luxurious grand hotel.

Emmentaler AOP

The king of Swiss cheese.

Scenic nature

Thanks to its unique geographical location at the heart of Europe, Switzerland is endowed with an extraordinary variety of scenic countryside.

Rhine falls circular route

The Rhine Falls are the centrepiece of this circular hike.

The Rhine Falls

By ship one can reach castles, the Rhine Falls Basin and even the mighty rock in the midst of the waterfall.

Oeschinensee – gondola rail

One of the most attractive and imposing mountain lakes, namely Oeschinensee, is reached by gondola rail from Kandersteg.

Kandersteg is located at 1,200 meters in the Bernese Oberland and offers a fantastic view of the Blümlisalp Massif.

Rivers and lakes

Discover the most beautiful lakes, rivers, streams, waterfalls and gorges in our country.

Chäserrugg – and the Churfirsten

From Chäserrugg, the mightiest of the seven peaks of the Churfirsten mountain range, you can enjoy unsurpassed views into six countries.

Nestled between the mighty Säntis massif and the seven Churfirsten peaks, the resorts of Alt St. Johann, Unterwasser and Wildhaus are among the highest-lying municipalities in Toggenburg.

Ruinaulta - Switzerland's Grand Canyon

10,000 years ago, 10 billion cubic metres of rock thundered into the valley.

On a raft through the Swiss Grand Canyon

The Rhine gorge is among Switzerland’s most beautiful locations for rafting.

Brissago

The lowest and oldest part of the village is clustered around the beautiful Renaissance church of St. Peter and Paul, surrounded by centuries-old cypresses.

Brissago - Ronco - Ascona

Strong fragrance of mimosas, well-tended Palm Gardens and simply unsurpassable views of the deep-blue Lago (Lake) Maggiore.

Around the Churfirsten

This moderately challenging loop takes you to the Wildhaus ski resort along a minor, little-known road and skirts magnificent Lake Walen.

Donkey trekking

The first item on this special walk is “donkey knowledge” before everybody prepares their “own” donkey.

Gruyère Pays-d'Enhaut Regional Nature Park

La Gruyère

The Gruyère region, with its rolling green landscape and the peaks of the Fribourg Pre-Alps, is home to the world-famous Gruyère cheese.

HR Giger Museum

As tourists savor a fondue outside on the square, the surreal works of H.R. Giger come alive inside the Château St. Germain castle.

Fribourg Region

The Pays de Fribourg is somewhat a world turned upside down: cold, limestone summits are found in the south and mild, even Mediterranean-like lakesides in the north.

Viamala Gorge

The Viamala is full of history and stories. 2000 years ago, the Romans passed through the gorge.

CabriO Stanserhorn

Enjoying the wind in one’s face and the perfect view.

Mountain railways

The journey to the top is an attraction in itself, be it onboard a cogwheel train, a cable car or the world’s steepest funicular.

Top attractions

Matterhorn

The Matterhorn: Switzerland’s most famous landmark. 4478 meters high and with its characteristic pyramid-shaped silhouette, this is probably the most photographed mountain in the world. You will be amazed by this majestic peak – whether hiking, skiing or from the comfort of a viewpoint.

Learn more about: Matterhorn

Learn more about: Matterhorn

Rhine Falls

The Rhine Falls near Schaffhausen is the most famous nature destination in Switzerland. Huge masses of water plunge down the rocks. You can experience the spectacle from Laufen Castle, from viewing platforms or on a boat trip.

Learn more about: Rhine Falls

Learn more about: Rhine Falls

On the Top of Europe: A visit to the Jungfraujoch puts a jewel in the crown of any visit to Switzerland.

Learn more about: Jungfraujoch

Learn more about: Jungfraujoch

Château de Chillon

Discover the most visited historical monument in Switzerland: Chillon Castle on Lake Geneva. Immerse yourself in 1000 years of history, explore medieval dungeons and enjoy the magnificent view of the lake and the mountains.

Learn more about: Château de Chillon

Learn more about: Château de Chillon

Creux du Van – Switzerland's Grand Canyon

A natural spectacle in the Neuchâtel Jura: The Creux du Van natural rock amphitheatre inspires you with 200-metre-high rock faces, wide views and pristine nature. One of the most impressive attractions in Switzerland.

Learn more about: Creux du Van – Switzerland's Grand Canyon

Learn more about: Creux du Van – Switzerland's Grand Canyon

Aletsch Glacier

Eleven billion tonnes of ice: this is the Aletsch Glacier. You’ll get the best view of the UNESCO Natural World Heritage site from the Jungfraujoch and the Aletsch Arena. The majestic landscape of ice, rock and snow, the glacial lakes and the Aletsch Forest will inspire you.

Learn more about: Aletsch Glacier

Learn more about: Aletsch Glacier

Swiss Museum of Transport

At the Swiss Museum of Transport in Lucerne, you will discover mobility, technology and communication on land, on water, in the air and in space. History comes alive, the future is tangible – an excursion in any weather.

Learn more about: Swiss Museum of Transport

Learn more about: Swiss Museum of Transport

Rhine Gorge (Ruinaulta)

The Rhine Gorge in Graubünden is one of the most impressive natural landscapes in Switzerland. Stand on the Il Spir viewing platform, hike along the Rhine or ride the Rhaetian Railway through the gorge.

Learn more about: Rhine Gorge (Ruinaulta)

Learn more about: Rhine Gorge (Ruinaulta)
